caption: Sh. 8. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5107)
reading: wosi : soreyi : (2)nsye : qowi : apote(3)l[.]ni stelo[.][.] (4)siwe tedḫ?elowi s(5)smri p?esilikr (6)terikelowi : ato : (7)mẖe psiẖeke(8)te : at mẖe : p[.][.](9)ḫrkete : ḫmlol (10)psiẖo[.][.][.]te
notes: soreyi: after e the copy shows two strokes and two 4-like forms (as in Sh. 11); read y + i. Line 1 name: n + closed 3 + three strokes; 3+/// could also be q + y. Line 2 '/ϟ' pairs read te; each could be o + l. ḫ in tedḫelowi is a U-shaped sign. Line 4-5 father's name: three 3-shaped signs (s/m/ẖ unsettled), a hatched S+long-tail sign (a or ke). Benedictions: the long-tailed Σ-topped sign is p or k (p chosen); the long-tailed 3 is k or ẖ. Line 10 ends after a dotted and hatched stretch with te? (or lo).
check_notes: Formula A table has the divider after mẖe; the copy clearly has it after ato and none after mẖe. Copy shows no divider between ḫmlol and psiẖo. The copy has one hatched width where the type has two signs (ẖ, t(?)); kept as one [.].

caption: Sh. 9. Altar (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5108)
reading: wosi : (2)asore(3)yi : sidokeñye : (4)qowi : nsye te?dḫelo(5)wi m[.]qel?li : te(6)rikelo(7)wi : (8)ato mẖe (9)psiẖte : a[.] (10)[.]mlo psḫkete
notes: (2) stands over an a whose tail is drawn dotted. In 'sinke?ñ?ye' the long-tailed 3 (k) and the ʌ-shaped sign (ñ, or n/d) are unsure. Line 5 name: first sign a damaged 3 with lower-left tail (m?), then hatching; '/3' read s+o (could be q). Line 10: 'a[.] [.]ẖ?e' is the 'at mẖe' place, the ẖ drawn as ℸ (m-shape); the hatched sign with a slash after it read o?.
check_notes: Copy shows a second hatched width before m that the type does not have. Copy shows e before te; the prose form psḫkete agrees with the copy.

caption: Sh. 10. Altar (Areika, Pl. 35, No. 5109)
reading: wosi sore?(2)yi kdi bye qo(3)wi temeykdiye (5)tedḫelowi ade?qenk : (6)terik?s?elowi ato (7)mẖe (8)psiẖeke(9)te at mẖ(10)e psiḫr[.]ke(11)te ḫmlolp ẖ[.]lkete
notes: Line 1: the e of sore? is a dotted outline with '?' above; a '?' also stands over the three strokes of by?e. No line number 4 is visible on the copy. Line 4: dotted oval = lost stretch, counted as two signs. 'ab : soenk': ab = S+2 and a hooked ν; '/3' read s+o (could be q); divider before 'so' partly dotted. 'sic' stands over the long-tailed 3 in terik?s?elowi (an extra 3-shaped sign before e).
check_notes: All entries agree with the checked reading.

caption: Sh. 11. Stela (Areika, Pl. 35, No. 5110)
reading: wosi : soreyi : mlke qowi : (2)ao?rmi[.]di : tedḫeli te[.][.]
notes: soreyi: after e two strokes and two 4-like forms, as in Sh. 8; read y + i. Name: a 7-shaped sign (m?), a small hook on the tail of a long-tailed 2 (l?), then S. Line 2: S and long-tailed 2 stand apart (a, or k + e); a small tick with '?' above (o?); a hatched 3-like sign (s?); N-shaped sign read n. Ends in hatching after a barred 4.
check_notes: Copy shows a small tick with Griffith's ? between a and r; type has none.

caption: Sh. 12. Altar (Areika, Pl. 35, No. 5111)
reading: wosi : so(2)reyi : (3)wit?iyb?qowi : wi?(4)kelt?le : tedḫelowi? kesote (5)ye terikelowi : to?(6)t?ep?emte (7)qowi mi (8)niye (9)tedḫelow?i medo mri te?(10)s?ye : terikelowi a(11)to mẖe psiẖebḫte (12)atmẖe psiḫr
notes: Several hatched signs in lines 3-4 read with '?'. Line 6 starts with a bar over a small stroke (read to?, unsure). 'kesote': '/3' read s+o (could be q). Line 9: N-shaped d, U-shaped ḫ; the w of low?i is drawn like a 3. Line 12 t is a small hook without a dot. The text ends at 'psiḫr' on the copy.
check_notes: The copy's bold 3-shaped sign before y does not look like t; kept as s?. The copy ends at psiḫr; bḫ(te) are not on the copy and are not added.

caption: Sh. 13. Altar (Areika, Pl. 36, No. 5113)
reading: wi?si so(2)rei : kel(3)molow[.] s?ite?li te(4)dḫeli tedḫeli ted(5)ḫelowi stemoeñ(6)kelqoli (7)teri(8)lowi a(9)to mẖe (10)psiẖeke(11)te atmẖe p(11)isiḫrke : ḫmlol : p(12)ẖolkete
notes: wo?si: the second sign is a small 4 with a dot, not a plain stroke. 'kel(3)solow': '/3' read s+o; it could be q (then 'qlow'). The first sign of line 4 has a dotted tail. Line 7: a crossed sign (ñ? or d). Line 8: 'sic' over the l of lowi; the sign before it is an x with dots (i?). The number 11 is printed twice, over te in line 11 and over i in 'p(11)isl?ḫrke'; both kept as printed. In line 11 an S sits inside the upturned tail of k.
check_notes: All entries agree with the checked reading.
